heading: The four that open the shop
blurb: Each lot is cut, cooked, or burnished in one run, then the run closes. Numbers are the order they leave the bench.

items.title: Java reed pen, cut to your angle
items.blurb: Seasoned three years, cut at the qatt you name. Ships with a bone qat'ah for the second cut.

items.title: Lamp-black ink, one cooking
items.blurb: Soot, gum arabic, and a long stir. Thirty bottles from a single pot, then the pot is done.

items.title: Ahar paper, burnished by hand
items.blurb: Sized with starch, dried flat, then run under agate until the surface refuses to bleed.

items.title: Walnut pen case
items.blurb: Holds four pens and a bottle upright. Lacquered inside, oiled outside, no hardware.
